criterion.anisotropy_is_reported_not_gated: A = (max-min)/mean over the three first-shell families is a ratio of noisy S values with a small denominator in the liquid, so it is reported and never thresholded
criterion.bragg_definition: bragg_ratio(trial) >= bragg_gate * bragg_ratio(liquid measured in the SAME run)
criterion.c6_definition: max over 60/120/180/240/300 deg of the normalized least-squares residual of the rotated occupied space (test_projection_convention.py); bounded in [0,1]; 3.0e-14 for a C6-covariant seed, 7.9e-01 for a C6-broken one
criterion.contrast_definition: site density over nearest-neighbour-midpoint density on the density smoothed at 0.4 l_B over 72 bins; 1 for anything uniform, and inf on the raw histogram
criterion.escape_hatch: if the Gaussian-seed reference fails the C6 gate, the run reports NO VERDICT rather than 0/N

random_measure.construction: c_row(v), the same map the optimiser uses
random_measure.name: haar_cp1
random_measure.statement: sin^2(t) ~ U[0,1] (the CP1 Fubini-Study CDF), phi ~ U[0, 2pi), i.i.d. over the nk momenta; E[sin^2 t] = 1/2

root_rs_note: the paper gives no numeric seeding coupling, only 'at large r_s'; r_s = 90 is this recipe's choice
root_selection: lowest E_final among trials with wc_formed true; None (and NOT the best-energy trial) when none pass
stage: 1A -- pipeline validation only; no scientific claim if no WC forms, because quick is SR 10x40 and a random determinant may simply not have had time
verdict_reason: 0/2 random starts formed a triangular WC at this budget.  This is NOT evidence the basin is unreachable -- it is equally consistent with the optimiser not having had time at quick; see the module docstring.
